meta_description: 24/7 Quick Plumbing offers fast, reliable plumbing services across Nottingham. Available day and night for emergencies. Call now for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, boiler fault, or blocked drain — we're on the road fast so your home is protected.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full bathroom installations, we handle every plumbing job across Nottingham and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Day or night, we respond fast to burst pipes, major leaks, and plumbing failures. Our rapid callout service means damage is contained before it becomes costly.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: We diagnose and repair boiler faults quickly to restore your heating and hot water. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running efficiently and safely all year round.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared using professional tools and techniques. We tackle everything from slow drains to completely blocked toilets with minimal disruption.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We locate the source accurately and carry out a lasting repair to protect your property.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fit-outs including toilets, basins, baths, and showers installed to a high standard. We manage the entire project from first fix through to final finish.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Power flushing, radiator installation, and full central heating system upgrades to improve efficiency and cut energy bills across your Nottingham home.

about_pullquote: We treat every Nottingham home as if it were our own.
about_para_1: 24/7 Quick Plumbing was founded with a simple goal: to give Nottingham homeowners a plumber they could genuinely rely on at any hour. With over a decade of hands-on experience across domestic and light commercial properties, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to honest pricing, clean workmanship, and genuine round-the-clock availability. We don't leave customers waiting — whether it's a Sunday evening emergency or a routine repair, you'll always speak to a real person and get a tradesman on site without delay.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a burst pipe and someone was at my door within the hour. Sorted the problem quickly, kept me informed throughout, and the price was very fair. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Used 24/7 Quick Plumbing for a boiler repair and then again for a full bathroom suite installation. Both jobs were done to a really high standard. Friendly, tidy, and reliable — would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had a stubborn blocked drain that two other plumbers couldn't shift. These lads came out the same day and had it cleared within the hour. Straight-talking, no hidden charges, and great value.
reviews.author: Darren H.
